summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: Here's the plan — no code touched, this is investigation + proposal only.  ## What I checked first (read-only)  Before proposing anything, I traced the whole chain statically, since the ticket's own hypothesis ("client-side wiring bug") needed verifying, not assuming:  - **`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`** — every route (list, get, create, update, delete, add/remove item) requires a session cookie, resolves it to a real `user_id` via `getSession()`, and filters/joins on `watchlists.user_id = userId`. Ownership checks are present on every mutating route. This looks correctly built, matching
